interpretation.success: The incident state machine cut operator pages by about 75% while retaining very low no-leak nuisance burden and preserving useful Hanoi localization.
interpretation.limitation: Six hours of below-threshold recovery is still too permissive for long intermittent leak signatures: true leaks reopen a median 3.5 times, mean 11.4 times, and one long event reopened 112 times.
interpretation.scoring_note: Incident-aware early-window coverage is tracked separately from a fresh post-onset incident start. Only one event in this cohort was already covered by a pre-existing incident, so this distinction does not explain the cohort's lower new-alert recall.
interpretation.next_iteration: Calibrate incident closure hysteresis on burned Hanoi-001/002 scenarios: lower close threshold plus longer sustained recovery, optimizing early coverage, nuisance rate, event fragmentation, and distinct-event separation. Test once on a fresh Hanoi-003 holdout.
